# We Are Clearance

> We Are Clearance is an online clearance store serving shoppers in the United Kingdom and Ireland with curated homeware, kitchen, gifts, lifestyle products, and everyday essentials at accessible prices.

Canonical website: https://weareclearance.com/

## Main collections

- Deals and accessible luxuries under £10
- Home & Living
- Kitchen & Dining
- Gifts
- Last Chance clearance

## Shopping features

- Product catalogue with search and department filters
- Prices displayed in GBP and EUR
- Basket and checkout experience
- Regular clearance and last-chance offers

## Crawling

- Public storefront: https://weareclearance.com/
- Sitemap: https://weareclearance.com/sitemap.xml
